info.name: Chaos Mesh Dashboard Archives Templates API
Chaos Mesh List status check templates

params.name: namespace
params.description: Kubernetes namespace to scope the request to.

items.docs: Returns a list of status check templates available for use in workflows. Status checks allow workflows to conditionally proceed based on external HTTP endpoint health checks.

info.name: Chaos Mesh Create a status check template

items.docs: Creates a new status check template that can be referenced in workflow definitions. The template defines an HTTP endpoint to poll and the criteria for determining success or failure.

info.name: Chaos Mesh Get a status check template

params.name: namespace
params.description: Kubernetes namespace to scope the request to.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the status check template.

items.docs: Returns the detailed definition of a specific status check template identified by namespace and name query parameters.

info.name: Chaos Mesh Update a status check template

items.docs: Updates an existing status check template. The full template definition must be provided in the request body.

info.name: Chaos Mesh Delete a status check template

params.name: namespace
params.description: Kubernetes namespace to scope the request to.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the status check template to delete.

items.docs: Deletes a status check template identified by namespace and name query parameters.
